fixture: Moving synthetic rectangle in real canvas MediaStream; controlled inference timing

checks.name: Delayed person masks cut out their own captured pose while the actual camera has moved
Slow successful worker results apply their matching frame and expire from completion rather than capture time
Cached or failed inference cannot attach an old mask to a new pose; the next success recovers
Hold original and Basic preview show the current camera without waiting for a person mask
Split comparison and downloaded PNG use the same captured pose as the completed mask
Shield, stop, camera mute and a hidden tab clear retained pairs and reject late inference
